text:
maria: Quick ask — onboarding a new customer (Acct: 123456789012) and need GPU quotas raised in eu-north-1 and ap-southeast-1. Target families: p4d, p5, g5. Expected steady footprint: p4d.24xlarge x8, p5.24xlarge x4, g5.48xlarge x10. Also need ENI/EFA limits and additional Elastic IPs. This is for Dedicated cluster (production), HIPAA-enabled, goal to be live in ~2 weeks. Any special steps?

sam: Can you open an AWS support case with the team? For new accounts/regions they always ask for usage history + business justification. Use this template when you file: 

```
Subject: Quota increase request — GPU instances + ENI/EFA for account 123456789012 in eu-north-1, ap-southeast-1

Body:
Account ID: 123456789012
Regions: eu-north-1 (primary), ap-southeast-1 (failover)
Requested resources:
- p4d.24xlarge: increase to 8 running On-Demand instances
- p5.24xlarge or equivalent: increase to 4 running On-Demand instances
- g5.48xlarge: increase to 10 running On-Demand instances
- Elastic Network Interfaces (ENI): increase to 200
- Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) attachments: increase to 50
- Elastic IP quota: increase to 50

Justification: Redwood Dedicated for AcmeHealth (HIPAA). Production inference workload with latency SLOs requiring GPU-backed pools. We can provide signed contract and expected monthly spend (~$200k/mo initially) and projected growth.

Business contact: Maria Lopez (maria@redwood.com)
Estimated go-live date: 2024-06-05
Attachments: contract, expected monthly usage, network design diagram
```

sam: Also attach the signed MSA and an invoice estimate — AWS support triage speeds up if you include a billing contact and expected spend in first 30/90 days.

lee: FYI for new regions they sometimes require capacity-specific checks. For p4d/p5 they might ask which AZs you plan to use — recommend listing 3 AZs in eu-north-1 and offering burst tolerance. Also request placement group awareness if you need low-latency NVLink.

lee: Small note on limits — ask for "Running On-Demand Standard GPU instances" quota for each instance type instead of a generic vCPU quota. I filed a similar ticket last month and AWS bumped p4d in ~48h when the justification included contract + expected run hours.

anna: Finance OK to cover initial commit for 6 weeks. Please add tags on instances: customer:acmehealth, env:prod, team:dedicated. We need a hard cap and alerting in Console to avoid surprise spend. :moneybag:

infra-bot: AWS Support case created (internal ref: INC-202406-4451). External case id: 9876543210. Status: Pending (requires AWS review).

maria: I opened the case (9876543210) and attached MSA + 90-day usage projection. I also included preferred AZs and that we need EFA in all requested AZs. AWS auto-reply says p4d capacity request will be reviewed in 24-72 hours; p5 requires manual quota review (3-7 days). g5 family was routable immediately but they want limit confirmations.

sam: Great. Once AWS approves, run a dry provisioning in a staging VPC (with same subnet sizing) so we can validate ENI and EFA attachments; I can help with Terraform module changes.

maria: Will do — scheduling a quick smoke window on Friday 09:00 UTC. I'll post results here.

infra-bot: Update on case 9876543210: AWS responded — p4d quota approved in eu-north-1 (8 instances). p5 review escalated to specialist (est. 5 business days). g5 increase approved. ENI & Elastic IP increases pending additional network diagram (upload requested).

lee: Thanks — I'll pull the subnet/ENI diagram from the repo and send it to support. Also note: if they ask for EBS quotas (gp3 IOPS/throughput) include the expected IOPS per instance; helps speed approval.

maria: Uploaded network diagram and EBS IOPS table. Case updated. ETA for final approvals now ~72h for the rest. Will update thread when we have final green light.

anna: Please CC finance on final approval so we can schedule the billing alert rules.

maria: CC'd. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
